name: Apathy - Midnight Collection ~Vol. 2~
original_name: アパシーミッドナイト・コレクション～Vol.2～
source:
Includes two different games:

Kikoku no Shou is a retelling of [url=https://vndb.org/v746]Apathy - Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi ~Visual Novel Version~[/url] from the 1995 timeline. It removes 6 out of the 7 stories and replaces them with new stories.

Apathy Narugamigakuen Toshidensetsu Tanteikyoku is a sidestory of the eponymous [url=https://vndb.org/v748]Apathy ~Narugami Gakuen Toshi Densetsu Tanteikyoku~[/url], from the 2008 timeline, and includes the scenario あじさい園の不幸を呼ぶ女.

[Adapted from the [url=https://nanakoro.booth.pm/items/1029514]official website[/url]]
